data.text: In that day seven women shall take hold of one man and say, “We will eat our own bread and wear our own clothes; only let us be called by your name. Take away our disgrace.”
In that day the branch of the LORD shall be beauty and glory, and the fruit of the land shall be pride and splendor for the survivors of Israel.
Whoever is left in Zion and remains in Jerusalem shall be called holy, everyone recorded for life in Jerusalem,
when the Lord has washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion and cleansed the blood of Jerusalem from her midst by a spirit of judgment and a spirit of burning.

Then the LORD will create over every dwelling place of Mount Zion and over her assemblies a cloud and smoke by day and the brightness of flaming fire by night; for over all the glory there shall be a canopy.
There shall be a shelter for shade from the heat by day, a refuge and hiding place from storm and rain.
